label.en: Average monthly private rent, all dwellings (Manchester, ONS PIPR)
label.ja: 平均月額民間家賃・全住宅（Manchester、ONS PIPR）

value.text: £1,373 per month, mean rent of all privately rented dwellings in Manchester local authority (E08000003), 2026-08; new and existing tenancies. Not university halls or student housing.

scope.en: Mean monthly private rent of ALL privately rented dwellings in Manchester local authority (new and existing tenancies). Not university halls, not student housing, not an average for international students, not by bedroom or property type.
scope.ja: マンチェスター市（地方自治体）の民間賃貸住宅すべての月額家賃の平均（新規契約と既存契約）。大学寮・学生向け住居・留学生の平均ではなく、寝室数や物件タイプ別でもありません。

meta.unit: GBP per month, rounded to the nearest £1
